subject: Milwaukee M18 FUEL SURGE impact driver $153.99 vs. Mac Tools $229.99
summary: A Milwaukee M18 FUEL SURGE hydraulic impact driver (bare tool) at $153.99 next to Mac Tools' brushless impact driver at $229.99.
body: Today's pick: the Milwaukee M18 FUEL SURGE 1/4" hex hydraulic impact driver (bare tool, 2761-20) is $153.99 at ToolNut, marked down from $199. Mac Tools lists its MCF886 20V MAX brushless 1/4" impact driver, also bare, at $229.99. That's $76 less, about 33%.
Different platforms, so check battery compatibility before you buy. If your bench already runs M18 packs, this is a cheap add.
Tip: ToolNut posts a new 24-hour doorbuster around 3 AM ET each day. Every deal we track is at offthetruckhq.com.
